content.short: HackenProof is a Web3 bug bounty and crowdsourced audit platform for crypto projects.
content.description: HackenProof connects blockchain projects with ethical hackers and smart contract auditors. Its public site describes bug bounty programs, crowdsourced audits, vulnerability reporting, triage workflows, and rewards for security researchers. It belongs under security tools because TON and other Web3 teams can use it to find issues before mainnet launches or production incidents. For TON builders and users, that means stronger review, monitoring, fraud detection, or safer launch processes before real funds are involved.
